events.title: Beetlejuice The Musical
events.description: Eddie Perfect's wacky musical adaptation of Tim Burton's cult film Beetlejuice brings big comedy, wild visuals, and an out-of-this-world score to the QPAC stage.

events.title: Macbeth – Shake & Stir Theatre Co
events.description: Shake & Stir Theatre Co. reimagines Shakespeare's gripping tragedy Macbeth for the modern age, exploring themes of ambition and power in a ratings-driven world.

events.title: GRIMM: Tales from the Brothers Grimm
events.description: This darkly playful theatre production returns, reimagining classic Brothers Grimm tales with a deliciously twisted edge at QPAC's Cremorne Theatre.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence (Exhibition)
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: A Brisbane-exclusive exhibition by Olafur Eliasson, inviting visitors on a multi-sensory journey through rocky landscapes, optical puzzles, and visionary cityscapes, spanning three decades of his work.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights – Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: GOMA transforms into a vibrant social celebration with DJs, pop-up performances, bespoke bars, and delicious bites, all built around the Olafur Eliasson: Presence exhibition.

events.title: Yoga at QAGOMA
events.location: Queensland Art Gallery / GOMA, South Brisbane
events.description: Join a therapeutic yoga session in the peaceful Gallery atmosphere, guided by a psychology PhD and trauma-sensitive yoga facilitator, offering a grounded, art-integrated wellbeing experience.

events.title: State Library of Queensland Building Tours
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: Explore the award-winning State Library of Queensland building, its collections, services, and current exhibitions with a friendly volunteer guide.

events.title: SLQ Explainer Series
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: A series of thoughtful conversations with experts, offering insights and context on current ideas, trends, and debates to help navigate complex questions without spin or hype.

events.title: World Press Photo Exhibition 2026
events.description: Brisbane Powerhouse showcases powerful photojournalism and documentary photography from around the globe, featuring a thought-provoking selection of the year's best images.

events.title: Opera Queensland – Rusalka (Dvořák)
events.description: Opera Queensland presents Dvořák's Rusalka, a lush production inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's 'The Little Mermaid,' by the creative team behind acclaimed Opera Australia productions.

events.title: Lose to Win – Belvoir St Theatre
events.description: Belvoir St Theatre presents 'Lose to Win,' a powerful true story where actor Mandela Mathia recounts his refugee journey from South Sudan to performing on Australian stages.

events.title: Archie Moore: kith and kin (Exhibition)
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: An immersive exhibition by Archie Moore, featuring extensive drawing that connects all human ancestors with nature to emphasize our kinship responsibilities to each other and our surroundings.

events.title: First Nations Guided Tours – QAGOMA
events.location: Queensland Art Gallery / GOMA, South Brisbane
events.description: A free monthly program inviting visitors to engage with the diverse stories, complex histories, and rich culture of First Nations artists and their work through guided tours.

events.title: 'The God of Small Things: Faith and Popular Culture' (Exhibition)
events.description: Drawing from Arundhati Roy's novel, this exhibition explores the omnipresence of faith in everyday life, focusing on the intersection between devotional imagery and popular culture.

events.title: Open Season Live Music Program
events.location: The Tivoli, The Princess Theatre, and other Brisbane spaces
events.description: Open Season continues with a diverse program of concerts, club nights, and international acts across various Brisbane venues including The Tivoli and The Princess Theatre.
